A survey point identifies a location selected for measurement.
Leveling compares heights using observations of a horizontal reference.
Map scale relates a distance on a map to a ground distance in the same units.
A coordinate describes a position within a specified reference system.
A baseline connects two observation stations.
A sensor converts an observed physical quantity into a recorded signal.
Elevation requires a stated vertical reference.
Precision describes agreement among repeated observations.
